summary: Area A20, the receiving end: the intake on the product site, the private tracker and daily triage. It is built, and its criteria proven against the live receiver, in the product site's own repository and its own chain, before the release Verify; this spec carries no build in this repository.
notes: The intake's protection measures (edge limits, a human check, revocable install identity, an 8 KB schema, deduplication, budgets, overflow and a kill switch; no shared install key) are candidates for this round's DEFINE, not criteria until ruled in.
title: Round 7: Ticket receiver
